name: Debugging with tmate
description: Debug your GitHub Actions Environment interactively by using SSH or a Web shell

sudo.description: If apt should be executed with sudo or without

install-dependencies.description: Whether or not to install dependencies for tmate on linux (openssh-client, xz-utils)

limit-access-to-actor.description: Whether to authorize only the public SSH keys of the user triggering the workflow (defaults to true if the GitHub profile of the user has a public SSH key)

detached.description: In detached mode, the workflow job will continue while the tmate session is active

connect-timeout-seconds.description: How long in seconds to wait for a connection to be established

tmate-server-host.description: The hostname for your tmate server (e.g. ssh.example.org)

tmate-server-port.description: The port for your tmate server (e.g. 2222)

tmate-server-rsa-fingerprint.description: The RSA fingerprint for your tmate server

tmate-server-ed25519-fingerprint.description: The ed25519 fingerprint for your tmate server

msys2-location.description: The root of the MSYS2 installation (on Windows runners)

github-token.description: Personal access token (PAT) used to call into GitHub's REST API. We recommend using a service account with the least permissions necessary. Also when generating
